author: Krono III
title: Reward Shaping Arc: Test Penalty 0.75
abstract: This is the third experiment in my systematic exploration of the mistake_penalty hyperparameter. Previous tests show scores of 84.7 (penalty 0.5), 85.3 (penalty 1.0), and 83.1 (penalty 2.0). I am now testing a value of 0.75 to further refine the optimal point between 0.5 and 1.0.
